component.name: useTracker
component.summary: Real-time image processing and blob tracking for scientific experiments

description.p: useTracker opens images, videos and USB cameras and runs a pipeline of plugins on them. Pipelines are built by stacking plugins; each one refines a shared mask that downstream plugins such as Extract Blobs and Track Blobs consume.

ul.li: Pattern tracking by template matching or CSRT
Deep-learning object detection with ONNX YOLO models
Background subtraction (MOG, MOG2, GMG, KNN, GSOC)
Image enhancement (white balance, CLAHE, curves, dehaze, denoise)
Zones of interest, H264 recording and CSV export

description.p: Cross-platform release: CMake build, SDL2 and Dear ImGui interface, modern FFmpeg and OpenCV 4/5 support, and prebuilt binaries for Linux, macOS and Windows.
